name: True North Sauna 8 Person 10' Long Barrel Sauna
description: Description This beautiful barrel sauna is expertly made by hand in Ontario, Canada. It has been developed for outdoor use in nature and can withstand any weather. It is 10 ' long and has an inside standing height of 6' . You can select an optional 2' porch (which decreases inside length). Different window options are available and you can choose if you want a wood stove or an electric heater inside. The sauna comes as a kit that requires assembly. Features: 2 wood options: White Cedar- slightly stronger and almost as resistant to rot and decay as red cedar, and has a beautiful light-colored finish. Red Cedar- naturally weather and insect-resistant, gives off a pleasant and recognizable scent and is aesthetically attractive. Comes standard with roof membrane & 2nd layer of roof boards Fascia boards to protect the end grain of the barrel wood 2 premium benches for sitting and reclining Partially pre-assembled construction with built-in venting holes Mounts on 2 wooden cradles Also Includes: 3 peg towel hanger, Vent kit, and cover, Screws for assembly, Flat floor , Door handles, Glassdoor, Benches Optional front and rear windows Optional 2' wide porch which decreases inside space accordingly. The total length remains the same. Specifications Specifications Seats: 8 people Size: 6.6' Diameter x 10' Long (311 cu.ft./ 250 cu.ft. w/ porch) Wood: White Cedar or Red Cedar Walls: 1.55" thick solid wood Door: Wood-framed glass Made in: Canada Assembly Assembly Guide
